review_notes: I read the whole file. The only definition is `multiplicity`, a one-line wrapper for `(s.filter fun i => label i = b).card`. It is namespaced and used in several downstream Ostmann and Heilbronn files. It is a thin named specialisation, not a competing representation of a Mathlib concept. The nearest Mathlib notions are `Multiset.count` on a mapped multiset and the `#{a ∈ s | g a = b}` cardinality that appears in `Finset.prod_comp`. Neither is a separate structure whose API this file reimplements. The theorems are standalone lemma-level matters, which the rubric excludes. `product_by_multiplicity` is close to `Finset.prod_comp`, but that is theorem duplication. I did not check every downstream use, so I abstained because the case for consolidation is unclear.
